insights.title: ₹9.8L Wasted on Free-Rider Promotions Weekly
insights.description: Two grocery campaigns (Eid Essentials 58% free-rider, Oil BOGO 57%) are hemorrhaging ₹6L/week in discount waste to loyal buyers who would purchase anyway. Snacks & Biscuits bundle shows 62% free-rider ratio with only 1.4× ROI.
insights.action: Immediately gate Eid Essentials and Oil BOGO to new-to-brand/lapsed segments only. Replace Weekend Snack Bundle with SKU-restricted mechanics. Projected recovery: ₹6L+ weekly.

insights.title: Cashback Mechanic Outperforming Bundles by 2.6×
insights.description: Loyalty Gold Cashback (Personal Care) delivering 3.7× ROI with only 31% free-riders vs. Weekend Snack Bundle's 1.4× ROI and 62% waste. Promo ROI trending up from 2.48 to 3.52 week-over-week.
insights.action: Reallocate ₹4-5L from underperforming bundle campaigns to cashback mechanics in high-margin categories. Test cashback expansion in Grocery & Staples to reduce current 41.2% chain-wide free-rider ratio.

insights.title: ₹6.2L Cost Passthrough Gap Eroding Margins
insights.description: India Gate Basmati 5kg margin compressed to 12.0% (8% cost increase not passed through). Chain-wide margin realization at 79.47%, down 1.4pp, with ₹6.2L weekly leakage from unactioned cost changes.
insights.action: Execute immediate price increase of ₹30 on India Gate Basmati. Audit all SKUs with cost updates >5% in past 45 days and schedule shelf price adjustments within 7 days to recover margin target.

insights.title: ₹40L Markdown Exposure with 69.83% Sell-Through
insights.description: Sell-through 5.17pp below target with ₹39.9L inventory at markdown risk. Premature markdowns already costing ₹3.4L weekly, suggesting reactive rather than predictive clearance strategy.
insights.action: Deploy dynamic markdown model for slow-movers before end-of-season crunch. Priority: Snacks & Biscuits (worst campaign category) and Grocery staples with promo overhang. Target 85% sell-through in next 3 weeks.
